messages.author: 91d503f5958d266c
messages.subject: GSOC-R 2015 blog post?
parts:
Dear colleagues in the R community,

We received news from Google yesterday that R has again been accepted into its Google Summer of Code program, so we are very happy to be participating again in summer 2015.

Is there anybody who has some time to write a blog post that will announce GSOC-R-2015 to the R community via http://www.r-bloggers.com/ ?

If so, I would appreciate it if you give links to the overview and timeline

https://github.com/rstats-gsoc/gsoc2015/wiki

and please encourage mentors and students to add/edit the table of proposed coding projects

https://github.com/rstats-gsoc/gsoc2015/wiki/table%20of%20proposed%20coding%20projects
